messages:
Jen K: quick proposal — introduce a lightweight 429 subcode and a `Retry-Info` response header so clients & SDKs can distinguish quota throttles vs transient queueing. Console would show a yellow 'degraded' badge on affected routes.
Samir: can you sketch the header shape? would prefer not to put JSON in header if we can avoid it.
Jen K: idea:
```
Retry-Info: type=quota;retry_after=28;quota_bucket=project-123
```
or a compact encoded form. advantage: easy to parse in clients and appears in logs.
Tanya V: +1 to distinguishing queueing vs hard throttle. But how do we represent 'best-effort' vs 'reject' behaviors? maybe `type=queue|reject|fallback`.
Ali (devex): SDK mapping question — should SDK raise `RateLimitError` with fields (.retryable, .quota_bucket) or return a typed error class? devex prefers typed classes for nicer try/catch for customers.
Samir: typed classes are fine, but keep wire-level stability: we should avoid adding new required headers for GA. make this opt-in via rollout header first.
Liz P: product POV — console copy should avoid technical terms. For users: 'Rate limiting applied; request may succeed if retried after Xs' or 'Requests are being queued; expect slower responses'. we need short tooltip copy.
Matt R: implementation constraints: backend routing already emits internal 'throttle_reason' tags. We can map those to `Retry-Info` tokens. Concern: CDN and caching strips unknown headers; we must ensure edge doesn't remove it.
Jen K: good catch — we'll use `X-Redwood-Retry` to avoid edge stripping and add a fallback field in the response body `retry_advice` for older clients.
Ali (devex): SDKs should prefer header, fall back to body parsing. Also expose `error.retryable` boolean and `error.retry_after` numeric.
Samir: telemetry: add `failure_reason` tag (quota|queue|fallback) and `route_degraded` bool so console can aggregate. Need mapping doc for infra.
Jen K: rollout plan: canary to 10% traffic for 1 week, wire up console badging (yellow) and add audible alert if route_degraded persists > 1h. create RFC PR.
Matt R: I'll add a changelog + infra mapping. assign to me for the header plumbing.
Tanya V: I'll own the console copy and tooltip, will send suggestions by EOD.
Ali (devex): I'll update SDK proto after header shape is finalized.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/retry-info-headers -> production (sha:abc123) :rocket:
Samir: minor nit — let's ensure the header keys are short to keep logs compact (X-RW-Retry?).
Jen K: open question: do we need a numeric subcode e.g., 429.1? that feels messy for HTTP semantics. prefer header.
Liz P: +1 header. keep status as 429 for clients.
Jen K: action items:
- Matt R: implement header + body fallback (due 2026-03-28)
- Ali (devex): SDK changes (due 2026-04-04)
- Tanya V: console copy + badge (due 2026-03-30)
- Samir: telemetry labels + alert (due 2026-03-29)
I'll open the RFC PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/789
Liz P: thanks, team. this feels actionable :thumbsup:
